svg.title: Execution partitions: hour bucket times 32 shards
svg.desc: Columns are hour buckets, rows are 32 shards. The current hour, 09:00, takes every claim and completion write: 20,000 a second, 625 per shard. Future hours take only creates, spread over time. A single partition without shards would need 20,000 writes a second against a 1,000 per second limit.
svg.text: partition key = hour bucket # shard (0–31), shard = hash(job) mod 32
claims + completions now: 10,000 / s × 2 = 20,000 writes / s
one partition takes 1,000 / s: unsharded it throttles 20×
32 shards: 20,000 ÷ 32 = 625 / s each, under the limit
